# The Gibbs sampler

## Example

```{r}
# Function to sample from conditional distributions 
sample_x2 = function(k=10000){
  # Specify parameters:
  n     = 16
  alpha = 2
  beta  = 10
  
  # Initialise:
  x = NULL
  y = NULL
  
  y[1] = 1
  x[1] = 0
  
  for (i in 2:k){
    x[i] = rbinom(n=1,size=n,prob=y[i-1])
    y[i] = rbeta(n=1,shape1=(x[i]+alpha),shape2=(n-x[i]+beta))
  }
  
  return(list(x=x,y=y))
}

n = 16
draws = sample_x2(k=100000)
x_full = draws$x
y_full = draws$y

xkeep2   = x_full[floor(100000/2):100000]
ns       = length(xkeep2)
xprobs_2 = sapply(0:n,function(x){sum((xkeep2==x))/ns})
```

```{r}
alpha = 2
beta_par = 10
theoretical = sapply(0:n, function(x){
  choose(n,x)*beta(x+alpha,n-x+beta_par)/beta(alpha,beta_par)
})

plot(0:n, 
     theoretical, 
     type = "l",
     lwd  = 2,
     col  = "purple",
     xlab = "x", 
     ylab = expression(pi(x)), 
     main = "Theoretical vs Gibbs.")
lines(0:n, 
      xprobs_2, 
      type = "l",  
      lty  = 2, 
      lwd  = 2,
      col  = "deeppink")
legend("topright", 
       legend = c("Theoretical", "Gibbs"),
       col = c("purple", "deeppink"), 
       lty = c(1,2), 
       bty = "n")
```

### Trace plots

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(1:100, y_full[1:100], type = "l", col = "deeppink",
     xlab = "Iteration", ylab = "y", main = "Iterations 1-100")
plot(1:500, y_full[1:500], type = "l", col = "deeppink",
     xlab = "Iteration", ylab = "y", main = "Iterations 1-500")
plot(25000:50000, y_full[25000:50000], type = "l", col = "deeppink",
     xlab = "Iteration", ylab = "y", main = "Iterations 25000-50000")
```

### Density distribution

```{r}
d100 = density(y_full[1:100])
d500 = density(y_full[1:500])

hist(y_full, 
     col = "lightblue", 
     border = NULL,
     breaks=50,
     lwd = 2, 
     probability = TRUE,
     main = "Density of y.", 
     xlab = "y")
lines(d100, col = "purple", lwd = 2)
lines(d500, col = "deeppink", lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("n=100", "n=500"),
       col = c("purple", "deeppink"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
```

## Question 2

```{r}
# Function to sample from conditional distributions 
gibbs_sampler_fxn = function(k=5000){
  # Specify parameters:
  p     = 0.5
  
  # Initialise:
  x = NULL
  y = NULL
  
  y[1] = 5
  x[1] = -5
  
  for (i in 2:k){
    x[i] = rnorm(n=1,p*y[i-1],1-p^2)
    y[i] = rnorm(n=1,p*x[i],1-p^2)
  }
  
  return(list(x=x,y=y))
}

p = 0.5
draws = gibbs_sampler_fxn(k=5000)
x_full = draws$x
y_full = draws$y

xkeep    = x_full[floor(5000/2):5000]
nsamp    = length(xkeep)
xprobs   = sapply(0:n,function(x){sum((xkeep==x))/nsamp})
```

### Trace plots

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(1:length(x_full), x_full, type = "l", col = "purple",
     xlab = "Iteration", ylab = "x", main = "Trace: X | Y, p")
plot(1:length(y_full), y_full, type = "l", col = "deeppink",
     xlab = "Iteration", ylab = "y", main = "Trace: Y | X, p")
```

### Density distributions (including burn-in)

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(x_full[1:100], 
     breaks = 30, 
     freq = FALSE, 
     col = "purple",
     xlab = "x", 
     main = "Histogram: x (first 100)")
curve(dnorm(x), add = TRUE, lwd = 2, lty = 2)

hist(y_full[1:100], 
     breaks = 30, 
     freq = FALSE, 
     col = "deeppink",
     xlab = "y", 
     main = "Histogram: y (first 100)")
curve(dnorm(x), add = TRUE, lwd = 2, lty = 2)
```

### Density distributions (excluding burn-in)

```{r}
keep   = (length(x_full)/2 + 1):length(x_full)  
x_post = x_full[keep]
y_post = y_full[keep]

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(x_post, 
     breaks = 30, 
     freq = FALSE, 
     col = "purple",
     xlab = "x", 
     main = "Histogram: x (post burn-in)")
curve(dnorm(x), add = TRUE, lwd = 2, lty = 2)

hist(y_post, 
     breaks = 30, 
     freq = FALSE, 
     col = "deeppink",
     xlab = "y", 
     main = "Histogram: y (post burn-in)")
curve(dnorm(x), add = TRUE, lwd = 2, lty = 2)
```

The histograms after excluding burn-in more closely resemble the distributions.
